name: Codit: Batch operations UI
description: Provides a user interface to run BatchOperations.
project_description: Codit: Batch operations UI is a submodule of Codit: Batch Operations that adds a web interface for running BatchOperation scripts. It lists the available scripts, shows each script's details and previous run logs, and provides a confirm-form flow to execute one — choosing whether to skip errors or fail on the first one. Running is gated by the parent module's restrict-access permission 'execute codit batch operations in ui'; the submodule is deliberately kept separate so a site can leave the UI disabled and enable it only when a maintenance operation needs to be run from the browser.
